caption: Lovely early Crocuses planted along the entrance kerb at Cluain Na Seimre, a gorgeous splash of purple in spring (March 2026)

The mature conifer boundary hedge at Cluain Na Seimre, with a flowering pink Weigela coming through at the base by the estate sign on the corner boulder. The dense conifer hedge gives year-round shelter for nesting birds and the Weigela throws an absolute riot of pink on the corner each May (May 2026)
